title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
About Tutor Trust

We're a proudly Northern charity that believes in equity in education. We do our bit to achieve that by partnering with schools and education providers, to enable their young people to work alongside inspiring and motivating tutors - an opportunity they may not otherwise have.

We know that our high-quality tuition helps improve young people's academic attainment, wellbeing, and self-confidence, and supports their personal aspirations.

The NTP which ran from 2020 to 2024 allowed us to reach more pupils than ever before. However, the end of NTP subsidies and other pressures on school budgets mean we are increasingly relying on fundraising, projects etc to enable us to continue to support a high number of pupils.

Our values

What we stand for and practise in everything we do at Tutor Trust:

We believe in fairness

We are passionate about making a difference

We are inclusive and supportive

We are quality-focused

We are ambitious

We learn

Benefits of working at Tutor Trust

Hybrid work model (2 days in the office)

Competitive leave - 33 days per annum (inclusive of Bank Holidays, pro rata)

Flexible working including Time Off In Lieu (TOIL)

Health and Wellbeing (Employee Assistance Programme, 24-hour GP service, mental health support and benefits platform, Perkbox)

Enhanced Family and Sick Leave (after a qualifying period).

Recognition and Culture (Thanks & Recognition, Highlights, team events)

Learning and Development (knowledge sharing, staff-led groups)

Job Purpose:

The role of Recruitment Coordinator will involve the administration of safer recruitment checks and the onboarding of new tutors. Alongside this, you'll handle the wider admin that keeps tutor recruitment moving: recruitment correspondence, enquiries from candidates, and keeping our Applicant Tracking System and Single Central Record up to date. You will assist the Recruitment Team in ensuring that the tutor recruitment process runs smoothly and effectively across all city regions that we work with. This role is Manchester-based but will cover recruitment over all Tutor Trust locations.

Job Responsibilities:

Safer recruitment

Administer safer recruitment checks for all tutors, including approving references, processing enhanced DBS checks, and overseeing Update Service renewals.

Maintain accurate records of safer recruitment checks for all tutors.

Ensure adherence to safer recruitment practices throughout the recruitment process.

Tutor recruitment & development processes

Update and maintain accurate records on the Tutor Application Tracking System and Single Central Record (SCR) along with other tracking of candidates.

Support with day-to-day administration and engagement of tutor trainees, including monitoring and supporting their progression.

Assist with all tutor interviews, training and tutor L&D events, which are currently taking place online. This includes acting as an Interview Coordinator during interviews, interviewing candidates, collecting and recording evidence of identification documents, and ensuring that interviews and other events run smoothly.

Assist with the complete recruitment process for tutors, including shortlisting, interviewing, and onboarding, alongside other members of the Recruitment & Development Team.

Administrative support

Provide administrative support to the R&D Team, including managing recruitment correspondence and data entry.

Support the tracking and analysis of recruitment data, to assist with the production of reports.

Respond to recruitment and training enquiries via email and phone, alongside other members of the Tutor Recruitment & Development team.

Assist with general office functions.

Safeguarding & Compliance
- Contribute to the monitoring and reporting of all safeguarding concern processes, within your teams, ensuring all concerns are reported promptly to the Designated Safeguarding Lead or deputies, and helping to promote and foster a culture of vigilance and accountability across The Tutor Trust.Take responsibility for monitoring safeguarding processes within your teams.

General Duties

Collaborate with colleagues across teams and regions to ensure consistent messaging and effective communication.

Assist other staff to complete a variety of tasks that enable the Trust to operate effectively and efficiently.

Any other duties commensurate with the grade and nature of the post.

Person Specification

Strong candidates for this role will demonstrate a solid track record of performance, possess excellent IT and English skills, exhibit strong interpersonal and diplomatic abilities, and show initiative in their approach.

Skills

Communication & Interpersonal Skills

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with stakeholders at all levels and across sectors.

Confident in representing the organisation in meetings, presentations, and events.

Organisational & Time Management

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.

Ability to work under pressure while maintaining consistently high standards of work.

Administrative and IT Skills

Proven administrative experience in a previous paid or voluntary role.

Fully IT literate, with particular competence in Microsoft Excel and Access.

Ability to manage office systems, databases, and documentation accurately and efficiently.

Independent and Team Working Skills

Able to work collaboratively as part of a team and independently when required.

Quick to grasp new concepts and adapt to changing priorities.

Attributes

Committed to safeguarding children and young people, and willing to undergo DBS clearance.

Alignment with the goals, ethos, and mission of the Tutor Trust.

Empathy for disadvantaged and vulnerable learners.

Enthusiastic and proactive in contributing to organisational growth and success.

Excellent time-management and attention to detail.

Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative working style.

Willingness to work outside standard hours when required.

General

How to apply

To apply, download an application form, an equality and diversity monitoring form and send your completed documents to the email address provided.

The role is based on a fixed-term basis from 4th January to 30th June 2027. Your regular place of work will be the Tutor Trust Head Office in Manchester; however, the position will also involve occasional travel to our partners.

The hours of work are 36.25 hours per week over 52 weeks (hybrid working currently in operation). Holiday entitlement will be 33 days per annum (inclusive of Bank Holidays). There may also involve working occasional unsocial hours in evenings.

The Tutor Trust is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people in line with Keeping Children Safe in Education. We expect all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All appointments are subject to safer recruitment procedures, including an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check, satisfactory references, and verification of the right to work in the UK.

The Tutor Trust is an Equal Opportunities Employer. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are committed to fair treatment throughout the recruitment process and beyond.

We believe that a diverse team drives innovation and strengthens the programmes we deliver to pupils. Diversity spans many dimensions of identity, and we are committed to cultivating an inclusive, equitable workplace where every voice is heard, respected, and valued.

title: Compliance Officer - Health & Social Care Recruitment
description:
Join Prospero Teaching - Where Passion Meets Purpose in Education!

For over 20 years, Prospero Teaching has been a trusted leader in connecting teaching and support staff with schools, academies, and nurseries across the UK and internationally. We proudly offer our services to a broad range of educational settings, including EYFS, Primary, Secondary, Further Education, SEN, and PRUs.

About the Role

As a Compliance Administrator, you will be a key member of our compliance team, responsible for ensuring candidates meet the necessary regulatory and internal requirements to work within the education sector. You will play a vital role in maintaining compliance with industry standards and fostering a smooth recruitment process for candidates.

Key Responsibilities
- Collaborate with the compliance team to ensure candidates meet all compliance standards for the education sector.
- Follow established operational processes and procedures to ensure adherence to regulations and industry standards.
- Guide and support candidates throughout the recruitment process.
- Conduct compliance checks, including but not limited to right-to-work, DBS, reference, and employment history verifications.
- Maintain and update accurate candidate records.
- Organise and verify candidate documentation.
- Respond to both internal and external inquiries efficiently and professionally.

About You

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented individual with:
- A good general education (minimum GCSEs in Maths and English, grades A-C, or equivalent).
- Strong relationship-building skills.
- The ability to work effectively under deadlines.
- Excellent administrative and organizational abilities, with a talent for prioritizing tasks.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- An understanding of confidentiality and data protection.
- A proactive problem-solving mindset.
- A commitment to safeguarding practices.

Benefits
- Competitive salary with a commission structure.
- Ongoing training and opportunities for professional development.
- Clear career advancement prospects within the company.
- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
- Private healthcare.
- Quarterly performance-based incentives.

Join us and be part of a team that's helping drive one of the UK's fastest-growing recruitment firms forward.

title: Experienced HR Administrator
description:
Experienced HR Administrator

Sale, Manchester M33

14.50 - 16.99 per hour (Depending on Level of Experience)

Monday - Friday

8am-3.30pm

ASAP - 4-month role

Our client, a prominent organisation within the Education sector, is seeking an Experienced HR Administrator to join their dynamic team. This is an exciting opportunity for an individual with a strong HR background to make a significant impact in a supportive and engaging environment.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Experienced HR Administrator, you will play a vital role in ensuring the smooth operation of HR functions. Your day-to-day tasks will include:
- Undertaking routine clerical duties including typing, photocopying and data input across various databases.
- Utilising Microsoft Office 365 packages, such as Outlook, Word, Excel, Publisher, Planner and SharePoint.
- Supporting the communication strategy by cohesive and clear messages ahead of key events, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all communications.
- Maintaining and updating intranet content and communication platforms to ensure that information remains accurate, accessible and current.
- Collaborating with the admin team to coordinate a central meeting schedule and manage logistics for key events.
- Taking high-quality notes during meetings as required.
- Booking and confirming travel arrangements for the central team when attending conferences and training sessions.
- Working closely with the central People and Culture team to manage HR casework, ensuring adherence to correct procedures for staff absence, grievance and capability issues.
- Maintaining accurate, confidential records in accordance with GDPR and data protection legislation.
- Providing administrative support.

Requirements:
- Proven experience in an HR administrative role is essential.
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 applications.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and manage sensitive information.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
- A collaborative mindset and the ability to build relationships with various stakeholders.

This role offers a unique chance to contribute to the educational landscape while developing your HR career in a rewarding environment. If you are passionate about HR and education, this is the position for you!

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Looking for a recruitment role where you can put your experience to good use without needing an HR qualification?

We're recruiting for a Recruitment Administrator to join the central recruitment team of a multi-school trust, supporting recruitment across three schools. If you have recruitment experience and enjoy keeping processes organised, this is a great opportunity to focus on the administrative side of recruitment and onboarding.

Paying 13.73 per hour, this is a six-month temporary opportunity offering just 20 hours per week, term-time only. With no CIPD qualification or formal HR background required, you can put your existing recruitment skills to good use in a varied role supporting school recruitment teams.
What will you be doing as a Recruitment Administrator?
- Supporting recruitment administration and onboarding across three schools.
- Preparing interview packs and making sure hiring managers have everything they need.
- Processing job offers and helping new starters complete their paperwork.
- Chasing references and checking that pre-employment documentation is complete.
- Processing DBS checks and monitoring progress to support safeguarding requirements.
- Managing recruitment queries through a shared inbox and updating systems, including TES.
- Posting job adverts and keeping recruitment records accurate and up to date.
- Providing wider administrative support, including absence records, special leave forms and welfare calls

What's in it for you?
- 13.73 per hour for your recruitment experience.
- Part-time hours of just 20 hours per week.
- Choice of working pattern: either 8am-12pm or 12pm-4pm, subject to the team's requirements.
- Term-time-only working, offering a different working pattern to a year-round role.
- No HR qualification required your recruitment knowledge and administration experience are what matter.
- Variety in your day: support recruitment and onboarding across three schools.
- Valuable experience: develop your skills within a central recruitment function and contribute to improving recruitment processes.

Why would you join this company?
- You'll be joining the central recruitment team of a multi-school trust, helping bring recruitment administration together across three schools.
- You'll work with school-based managers and a range of stakeholders, playing an important part in keeping recruitment processes organised, consistent and running smoothly.
- This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys recruitment but would prefer to focus on administration, coordination and onboarding rather than a traditional recruitment consultant role or a generalist HR position.

What we're looking for
What's essential:
- Previous recruitment experience and a good understanding of the recruitment lifecycle.
- Experience supporting recruitment administration and onboarding.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel.
- Experience maintaining recruitment documentation, tracking outstanding information and keeping records up to date.

What's helpful but not essential:
- Experience working in a school, education setting or multi-academy trust.
- Familiarity with TES or another recruitment or applicant tracking system.
- Experience coordinating DBS checks and pre-employment screening.

The Essentials
Pay: 13.73 per hour.
Hours: 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, either 8am 12pm or 12pm 4pm.
Working pattern: Term-time only.
Location: Confidential multi-school trust, supporting three schools.
Job type: Temporary, six-month assignment, expected to run until April.
DBS: An enhanced DBS check is required. An existing DBS on the Update Service isn't essential, as a risk-assessed start may be considered while checks are completed, subject to the organisation's safeguarding procedures and approval.

To Apply
If you're looking for a part-time recruitment administration role where you can use your existing skills, enjoy variety and support a busy recruitment team, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply now by sending your CV. We aim to respond to all successful applications within 2 days. If you haven't been contacted within 2 days your application has been unsuccessful. Please check our website and apply directly for any other suitable positions you see. We apologise that we are unable to contact everyone in person and thank you for your interest. Jobwise Ltd is an employment agency and the details sent in your application may be stored on our secure database.
